items.title: Howard Johnson interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 14, 2019
items.q: You played with Archie Shepp and some people say that much of that music sounds angry.

ctx.x: So I’m like, “Okay, you still win.” I mean I wasn’t trying to make it that but it got to be that.

That’s a great — that’s some drama there, boy, that is jazz drama. I can just picture it, and the audience, like okay what’s Mingus going to do next, and how’s this young man going to respond. That’s a really cool story. Wow. Just, and a long line, of I was trying to think of people who you haven’t played with, and that’s sort of hard. But you seemed to enter the jazz world with pretty progressive music, right? You played with Archie Shepp and some people say that much of that music sounds angry.
